Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 127: October 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #127 shipped to subscribers in September 2011 (bearing the cover date of October 2011 for Issue 127). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #127 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Sonic Generations (platformer)
Spider-Man: Edge of Time (action-adventure)
NBA 2K12 (sports simulation)
Dungeon Defenders (Xbox Live Arcade tower defense action RPG)
Daytona USA (Xbox Live Arcade arcade racing port)
Pinball FX 2: Marvel Pinball (Xbox Live Arcade virtual pinball expansion)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, Mass Effect 3, and BioShock Infinite, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
